title: Influence under coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ be a coordinate among the last $n$ coordinates. The influence of that coordinate equals the average of its influences in the two restrictions of $f$ obtained by fixing the first coordinate to $1$ and to $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube
A coordinate $i$ among the last $n$ coordinates
